infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sprig uses the camera so you can photograph a plant the moment you spot it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sprig lets you add photos from your library to a find.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Sprig can save a find's photo back to your library when you export it.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sprig tags each find with where you saw it so you can come back later. Location is stored only on your device.
